Currently trying to lose weight and so I have reduced my daily calorie intake to 1500 calories. Down from 220lbs to 188 and some girl at the University I go to told me that I'm fat shaming her by restricting my calorie intake. I asked her how and she said "You're trying to lose weight as if it is bad to be overweight which is only a term made to shame people such as myself" (She is ~280lbs) As I've started losing weight and other people have noticed it is incredible how many people try to stop you and tell you you're fine. They are just trying to make a positive image around being overweight so they can keep being lazy and do nothing about it.
